analysis.headline: Shares Your Info Extensively
analysis.quote: We share information we collect, infrastructure, systems and technology with the other Meta Companies.

analysis.headline: Shares for Personalized Ads
analysis.quote: We’ll use information that advertisers, businesses and other partners provide us about activity off Meta Company Products that we have associated with you to personalize ads that we show you on our Products, and on websites, apps and devices that use our advertising services.

analysis.headline: Shares with Integrated Partners
analysis.quote: If you do, these integrated partners receive information about you and your activity.

analysis.headline: Trains AI with Your Content
analysis.quote: We also use manual review to access and review your information.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Info Indefinitely
analysis.quote: We keep information as long as we need it to provide our Products, comply with legal obligations or protect our or other’s interests.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Devices
analysis.quote: For some of these purposes, we use information across our Products and across your devices.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Sensitive Data
analysis.quote: Any information with special protections that you choose to provide, such as your religious views, your sexual orientation, political views, health, racial or ethnic origin, philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, or as part of surveys you choose to participate in, and where you have given your explicit consent

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Law Enforcement
analysis.quote: We access, preserve, use and share your information: In response to legal requests, like search warrants, court orders, production orders or subpoenas.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Across Products
analysis.quote: We share information we collect globally, both internally across our offices and data centers and externally with our partners, third parties and service providers.
